shortDescription: Specialist pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Rohini Josan Malik (Pedodontist, 12+ Years Practice). Offering infant oral care, milk tooth restorations, special needs dentistry, and hospital-grade safety at Max Hospital.

doctor.title: Lead Specialist Pediatric Dentist (Pedodontist)
doctor.qualifications: Specialist Pediatric Dental Surgeon • General & Hospital Dental Practice
doctor.philosophy: Every child deserves a warm, fear-free introduction to dental care. We build positive experiences through gentle behavioral guidance and reassuring communication that lasts a lifetime.
credentials: Over 12 Years of specialized clinical practice in pediatric dentistry (practicing since 2012)
Consultant Pediatric Dentist at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mohali
Advanced training in behavioral guidance and sensory-adapted dental care
Comprehensive care for children with special healthcare needs (including ASD)
Painless milk tooth restorative procedures and pediatric zirconia crowns
